observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor event space with a checkered floor, likely a wedding or celebration
observation.dancers: group of men, all adults or young adults
observation.formation_and_space: loose circle formation, with dancers moving in and out of the center
observation.posture: upright torso, knees bent, weight shifted frequently to accommodate quick movements
observation.footwork: quick, rhythmic stepping, often involving small jumps and weight shifts on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms are held up, often with hands holding sticks or scarves, moving in coordination with the rhythm
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal hip movement, torso remains relatively stable while the arms and legs are active
observation.partnering: no direct physical contact, but dancers interact by moving around each other and coordinating their stick movements
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent small jumps, occasional crouching or kneeling, and quick turns
observation.costume_and_props: traditional clothing including long tunics (kameez) and trousers (shalwar), some wearing vests; many hold sticks
observation.cannot_infer: the exact nature of the stick movements and the speed of the footwork are difficult to determine due to the low resolution and camera movement
